verdict.rationale: Puzzle's 'AI Close' explicitly automates month-end close by reconciling accounts, reviewing transactions, and surfacing discrepancies (puzzle-docs-24/39), and separate reconciliation docs describe matching bank/credit card transactions (puzzle-docs-29). Cash and accrual accounting are supported (puzzle-docs-20), but there's no evidence of a structured checklist UI, accrual-specific tasks, or multi-person review/sign-off workflow tracking. Missing for 10: explicit checklist/task-list feature, accrual entry tracking, and reviewer sign-off/approval workflow evidence.
